preview.readerIsPlanetHolder: Your affection makes Bird feel liked and accepted when they show up as themselves, and they quickly notice what seems to please you. Because your response matters so much, they may start changing their manner or appearance to keep your approval, until presenting themselves freely feels harder. Your affection can also help them feel valued without tying their worth to external validation.
